2027 Proposed Projects

The following projects have been proposed by our mentors as a starting point. Please note that project descriptions may change depending on discussions between mentor and mentee.

Faculty Affiliation Project Description Expected Qualifications
Erik Fredericks GVSU This project will explore how evolutionary computation can support procedural content generation in video games. Students will develop an artificial life simulator using Godot that can be used to explore open-ended evolution in the context of a game environment. Students are expected to have programming experience. Python and Godot experience preferred.
Erik Fredericks GVSU This project will develop software testing techniques for robotics. Students will use evolutionary computation to generate test suites that discover latent flaws in both simulated and physical robot controllers. Students are expected to have programming experience. Python and ROS experience preferred.
